name: Bangkok
intro: Massive convention halls like IMPACT Arena, seamless visa exemption for Indian passport holders, and dynamic riverfront networking.
access: Direct flights from Delhi, roughly four hours.
highlights: Among the lowest cost per delegate of any international option, which is often what makes a first overseas offsite approvable.
Deep hotel supply at every standard, so a large group can be accommodated on one property rather than split across three.
Straightforward entry process and heavy flight capacity from India.
planning_note: City traffic is the hidden cost. A venue twenty minutes away on a map can take an hour at the wrong time, so build the day around location rather than price alone.
